notes.title: MareQuest: An Interactive Tail Updates
notes.content:
[h3]Hello fellow mare enthusiasts! There's been pretty good progress with MareQuest: An Interactive Tail over the past few months. Still no exact release date, but rest assured we're working hard to make it a fun and unique experience, not only for the mare gaming industry but the gaming industry in general. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118609/c56bdbfefc43bfcee4ff50d7ba03503d8fccbd64.png[/img]

[h3]Being completely modest, we have GOTY 2023 on lockdown. There's no competition whatsoever. I have seen the future and it is mare. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118609/131b95b8200ddec9c710b63399a3a30f3c7796a2.png[/img]

[h3]I'm hesitant to give all of our trade secrets, but I will say some neat features of the new game include a cute and (hopefully) well written story, important friendship choices, inventory and friendship management, adorable random interactions, a unique battle mode, level ups and perks, and INFINITE MARES. I love them.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118609/5a940b366946612527e3f2215926550eb6df9305.png[/img]

[h3]More to come! Thank you for your continued interest and support! Pretty soon our goal of world peace through mare conquest will be fully realized.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118609/2f5932d17bf66eca0fa1e3f45230b145da885af7.png[/img]

If you've read this far you are a wonderful individual and are loved. Now you are required by mare law to put a smile on your face or the pasta police will confiscate your spaghetties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118609/f3e25a6aad2f9afc6100ef08718673523988b450.png[/img]

[h1]Have a cute mare song ^:) [/h1]

[previewyoutube=ymkbOKwHJi4;full][/previewyoutube]



Spooky horse D:^ 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118609/951bfbef0a14f49c24bfe0ea3b9b4dd18530077b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118609/a722199c5d66f06db8efb296b721ada063b413a3.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: MareQuest Alpha 0.1.1 Update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2laFBgNV2fE;full][/previewyoutube]

Guide: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2895803916
OST Part 1: https://electrokaplosion.bandcamp.com/album/marequest-ost-part-i
OST Part 2: https://electrokaplosion.bandcamp.com/album/marequest-ost-part-ii

IMPORTANT: THIS UPDATE IS NOT COMPATIBLE WITH PREVIOUS SAVE FILES! IT IS STRONGLY RECOMMENDED YOU CREATE A NEW SAVE FILE!

Changelog:
Alpha: 0.1.1 (Kind Spirits)
Last Updated 09-FEB-2022 @1200CST

IMPORTANT: THIS UPDATE IS NOT COMPATIBLE WITH PREVIOUS SAVE FILES! IT IS STRONGLY RECOMMENDED YOU CREATE A NEW SAVE FILE!

New Features: 

>15 Track OST!
	-30 original songs now for MareQuest
	-Special 30th song unlocked for anyone who has beat the game

>7 New Quests
	>Art Gallery - Grass Biome [Drawing Game]
	>MareBall - Grass Biome [Pong]
	>Filly Delivery - Desert Biome [Flappy Bird?]
	>Mareditation - Far North/South
	>PacMare - Snow Biome
	>Snowball fight - Snow Biome
	>Ice Cream Truck - Desert Biome

>Trigger Perks - You can now trigger specific perks with F key (arrow movement) or right mouse (WASD)
	-Cloud - Trigger when flying. Costs 1 sugarcube
	-Applebuck - Trigger when running. Costs 1 Green Apple
	-Shield Recharge - Trigger when sitting. Costs 1 Red Apple
	-Alicorn Perks (Sun/Moon/Frienship) - Trigger when sleeping/laying down
		--Perks now show recharge time in HUD. The perk will be selected green depending on your stance
		--Switched sugarcubes to 1 and red apples to 3 to be more intuitive with trigger perks/stances
	
>Added Food Stand for Earth Mares
	-costs 15 wood
	-hungry mares will randomly spawn and walk towards food stand

>Added favorites in menu
	-clicking a star will save current mare configuration (if a trashcon icon appears below the favorite the save worked)
	-clicking star again will load the mare in
	-clicking the trashcan will delete the favorite

>Added rocks
	-They're rocks, it's incredible.

>Added Experimental Retro Mode
	-Custom shader, requires GPU 
	-May result in bugs. If screen goes blank, press "R" on main menu to turn off	

Bugs Fixed:
>cuddle mares have white shadows
>hats disappearing when booping
>drawing issue on subpixel coords
>infinite dialogue from NPCs when starting quests
>exiting caves may result without friending nereby mare followers
>HP 0 causes weird graphics issues
>getting HP 0 in caves gives anonymous mare ending
>getting HP 0 always sets friend count to 2
>a million other things I never wrote down ^:)c

Optmizations: 
>WASD/Arrow Keys now work for Egg Mare minigame
>made text box border pixel perfect
>raising stance from sitting now goes to standing instead of flying
>added keyboard controls to poni poni dance club end screen
>changed blue and purple mare colors in marestermind minigame slightly for colorblindness ease
>made tree transition between biomes a bit more fluid
>made hat animations for applebucking
>standardized quest text
>remade and resized in game HUD
>remade key bindings in menu

Known Issues:
>experimental CRT mode may cause bugs and graphical issues
>Pegasi can get stuck on maze/cave walls
>Health/stamina bar may entend outside of GUI in certain circumstances
>Stamina regen bar may only fill up half way in Hordecore minigame
>Abilities may toggle on when changing rooms
>Quest completion resulting in level up may break if your browser crashes before the level up screen is displayed. This will prevent future level ups as well 
>Sugarcube buff may not reset when returning to overworld
